note: Per-crop values for the soil and water columns (web/js/soilwater.js). null means no source was found; the app lists it as an information gap.

sources.FAO56_T12: Allen et al. 1998, FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 12 (single crop coefficients Kc), fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm
sources.FAO56_T11: FAO-56 Table 11 (lengths of crop development stages)
sources.FAO56_PLANT: FAO-56 Ch. 6: spring wheat is sown when the 10-day running mean air temperature reaches 5 C, maize when it reaches 13 C
sources.FAO56_ET0: FAO-56 Eq. 52 (Hargreaves ET0) and Eq. 21 (extraterrestrial radiation)
sources.OMAFRA_USLE: OMAFRA Factsheet 23-005, Universal Soil Loss Equation (2023), Table 4 crop type factor and Table 5 tillage factor
sources.CRAAQ_N: Nitrogen grid for grain corn by climate zone (CPVQ 1996, Agri-Reseau feuillet 4B); same rates in the CRAAQ fertilization guide
sources.MAPAQ_WHEAT_N: MAPAQ, Grilles de reference ble, orge, avoine: spring wheat 120 kg N/ha, 90 kg N/ha on G1 soils with more than 4 % organic matter
sources.CRAAQ_SOY_N: CRAAQ fertilization guide via La Terre de chez nous (2018): soybean 0 to 30 kg N/ha
sources.SOY_CREDIT: CRAAQ 2010 soybean credit of 25 kg N/ha to the next crop, cited by N'Dayegamiye et al. 2012, Sustainable Agriculture Research 1(2):257, doi 10.5539/sar.v1n2p257 (they measured 31 to 42)
sources.CPVQ_CREDIT: CPVQ residue credit table (Agri-Reseau feuillet 4B): grain corn 0, spring wheat 0, barley 0, oats 0
sources.GAGNON_ROT: Gagnon et al. 2019, Agronomy Journal 111(6), doi 10.2134/agronj2018.10.0653: on a Quebec clay soil, corn in rotation yielded 0.6 to 0.9 Mg/ha (mean 0.7) more than continuous or second-year corn, under plough and reduced tillage
sources.LAL_RATIO: Lal 2005, World crop residues production and implications of its use as a biofuel, Environment International 31:575, residue to grain ratios (Lal 1995 column)
sources.CGQ_YIELD: Concertation Grains Quebec (2025), mean Quebec yields 1981 to 2023
sources.OMAFRA_811_SOY: OMAFRA Publication 811, Agronomy Guide for Field Crops (2022), ch. 2: if soil temperature and moisture conditions are suitable for planting corn, they are generally also suitable for soybeans
sources.OMAFRA_811_BUCK: OMAFRA Publication 811 (2022), ch. 7 Buckwheat: Table 7-1 maximum nitrogen 35 kg/ha southern Ontario, 55 kg/ha northern Ontario; 70 to 90 days from planting to maturity; should not rotate with soybeans, edible beans, canola or sunflowers (white mould)
sources.MAPAQ_CEREAL_N: MAPAQ, Grilles de reference en fertilisation ble, avoine et orge: barley 60 to 90 kg N/ha on G1 soils, 90 on G2 and G3; oats 25 to 75 kg N/ha by texture group and organic matter
sources.FPCCQ_CANOLA_N: FPCCQ, Guide de production du canola (2013), quoting the CRAAQ grid: 80 to 120 kg N/ha
sources.STATCAN_YIELD: Statistics Canada Table 32-10-0359-01, Quebec mean yield 2021 to 2025 (a different period from CGQ_YIELD)
sources.IPCC_RESIDUE: IPCC 2006 Guidelines, Vol. 4, Ch. 11, Table 11.2: above-ground residue = slope x dry yield + intercept, worked out at the Quebec yield; a different method from LAL_RATIO

soybean.name: Soybean
soybean.kc_note: the initial value 0.4 is the FAO-56 legume group value, assumed for soybean
soybean.plant_note: the maize rule; OMAFRA: conditions suitable for corn are generally suitable for soybean

wheat.name: Spring wheat
wheat.kc_note: end value 0.25 to 0.4 in FAO-56; 0.3 used
wheat.stages_note: sown March or April at 35 to 45 degrees latitude

barley.name: Barley
barley.stages_note: the Barley/Oats/Wheat row sown March or April at 35 to 45 degrees latitude, as for wheat
barley.plant_note: assumption: sown with the spring wheat rule; barley shares the FAO-56 Barley/Oats/Wheat stage row

oat.name: Oats
oat.stages_note: the Barley/Oats/Wheat row sown March or April at 35 to 45 degrees latitude, as for wheat
oat.plant_note: assumption: sown with the spring wheat rule; oats share the FAO-56 Barley/Oats/Wheat stage row

canola.name: Canola
canola.kc_note: mid value 1.0 to 1.15 in FAO-56; 1.15 used
canola.stages_note: canola has no row in FAO-56 Table 11
canola.plant_note: OMAFRA gives a soil temperature (5 C), not an air temperature rule

buckwheat.name: Buckwheat
buckwheat.kc_note: buckwheat is not in FAO-56 Table 12
buckwheat.usle_note: assumption: counted as a cereal; OMAFRA Table 4 has no buckwheat row
buckwheat.n_note: assumption: Ontario maxima (no Quebec grid found); southern 35, northern 55 kg N/ha
buckwheat.ratio_note: assumption: IPCC has no buckwheat row; the generic Grains row (slope 1.09, intercept 0.88) is used

heavy_rain_note: a day with 25 mm or more of rain, above 0 C, April to November; the cut-off is this tool's choice, not a published threshold

rotation_conflicts.why: white mould (sclerotinia) affects buckwheat, soybean and canola; OMAFRA advises not to rotate buckwheat with them
